zh-CN.title: 统一导入导出与弹窗体验升级

sections.title: ⚠️ 重要提醒
items: 导入导出文件已统一为新的固定 v1 格式，旧版命令库和配置备份无法直接导入

sections.title: 导入、导出与配置
items: 统一抽屉命令库与设置页配置的导入导出协议，两种文件均使用固定的 v1 格式并可相互识别
设置页导入时会根据文件内容提示仅导入命令或导入完整配置，抽屉也可从配置文件中提取命令
设置页新增“恢复默认配置”，只重置插件设置并保留命令、分类、输出触发器、运行日志和使用统计
设置页按钮简化为“导入”和“导出”，并优化按钮尺寸及导入提示排版

sections.title: 界面优化
items: 统一抽屉操作弹窗与设置页配置弹窗的主题样式，增加标题和操作区分隔线并重新平衡间距
重新设计命令库导入预览，以紧凑的 2×2 统计、导入规则和结构化冲突详情展示导入结果
优化移动命令、删除命令和删除分类提示，重点标记命令名称与受影响的命令数量

sections.title: 英文支持与文档
items: 新增完整英文 README，并在中英文文档间提供语言切换入口
英文界面新增命令时默认名称改为“New command”，切换语言时不会覆盖用户已输入的名称
补充导入导出、恢复默认配置、导入预览和弹窗提示的英文翻译

zh-CN.notice: 本版本采用新的固定 v1 导出格式，不兼容旧版命令库或配置备份；更新安装完成后需要重启 Tabby。

en.title: Unified import/export and improved dialogs

sections.title: ⚠️ Important
items: Import and export files now use the new fixed v1 format; older command-library and configuration backups cannot be imported directly

sections.title: Import, export, and settings
items: Unify drawer command-library and Settings configuration files under a fixed v1 protocol that both import locations can recognize
Let Settings choose between importing commands and the full configuration, while drawer imports can extract commands from configuration files
Add Restore defaults to Settings, resetting plugin preferences while preserving commands, categories, output triggers, runtime logs, and usage statistics
Simplify the Settings actions to Import and Export, with content-sized buttons and clearer two-line import prompts

sections.title: Interface improvements
items: Apply theme-aware styling to drawer action dialogs and Settings configuration dialogs, with clearer header and action separators and balanced spacing
Redesign the command-library import preview with compact 2-by-2 statistics, import rules, and structured conflict details
Improve move, delete-command, and delete-category confirmations by emphasizing command names and affected command counts

sections.title: English support and documentation
items: Add a complete English README with language links between the Chinese and English documentation
Use “New command” as the default name in the English interface without overwriting names already entered when the language changes
Complete English translations for import/export, Restore defaults, import previews, and dialog prompts

en.notice: This release uses the new fixed v1 export format and cannot import older command-library or configuration backups. Restart Tabby after installation.
